run_cli_query_dataset: run the cli to query a dataset with offset and limit options
run_cli_index_parquet: run the cli to download and index parquet files from a dataset
run_cli_load_from_hub: run the cli to load a dataset from the Hugging Face Hub
run_cli_load_from_cache: run the cli to load a dataset from the local cache
review_cli_command_group: review the cli command group that initializes dataset loading with revision and metadata options
